title: Capstone checkpoint
prompt: Assemble the platform core as `class JobPlatform`. Constructor: `JobPlatform(int capacity)`. Methods: `(bool accepted) Submit(string jobId, Func<int> work)` — accepts only if the jobId was never seen ANDin-flight count < capacity (idempotency + backpressure; duplicates and over-capacity return false and count as rejected); `int RunAll()` — executes every accepted job exactly once (chronologically), returns the work-counter delta (equals accepted count — proving each job ran once); `int Pending` property. Then `static (int accepted, int rejected, int executed) SubmitSchedule(JobPlatform p, List<string> jobIds, int duplicatesPerJob)` — submits each id (1 + duplicatesPerJob) times, returns accepted/rejected counts and executed = RunAll().

tests.name: idempotent-and-bounded
tests.hint: HashSet<string> seen + a pending list; accept when !seen.Contains && pending.Count < capacity.

tests.name: schedule-runs-once
tests.hint: SubmitSchedule: deliver each id (1+duplicates) times; executed = p.RunAll(); work counter shared.
